newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran president opens $100 mln gas injection project.
newsitem.headline: Iran president opens $100 mln gas injection project.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani on Monday inaugurated a $100 million gas injection project in southwestern Iran, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.
It said the project will inject about 270 million cubic feet of gas per day through four wells attached to the Bibi-Hakimeh oilfield.

The project, built in six years for 175 billion rials ($100 million) in Kohkilouyeh-Boyer Ahmad province, will boost the accessible oil reserves of the field by more than one billion barrels, IRNA said.
($1=1,750 rials at the rate used for state budget accounts)
